notablePrerequisites:
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Necrotic Ooze using Stern Marshal's ability by tapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
